evals.prompt: 请深入分析和审阅 .trellis/tasks/08-20-settings-font-picker-repaint 这份规划
evals.expected_output: Skill triggers. Locates the root task directory (searching other repositories when the path is not in the working repo), resolves recursive current/archive children, runs plan_precheck.py once for the ordered scope, then runs the judgment passes per member and across the tree. Writes one scope-plus-evidence report to the reviewed project's .trellis/reviews directory, prints the aggregate verdict and root report path, and emits one copyable scope-wide handoff prompt in a text fence. Does not edit planning artifacts or product code.
assertions: Reads task.json first and uses its status to decide whether the drift pass applies
Runs the bundled precheck script and reports blocking items before the judgment passes
Verifies path:line citations against the actual repository instead of accepting them
Writes one report to .trellis/reviews/<root-task-name>.md via one write_review_report.py call
Prints an aggregate verdict line, one report path, and one copyable scope-wide handoff prompt in a text fence
Does not edit prd.md, design.md, implement.md, the jsonl manifests, or any code
Does not run task.py start or any state-writing Trellis command
Reports the git state of the .trellis/reviews destination as a non-blocking note and never edits .gitignore

evals.prompt: Review the trellis plan under .trellis/tasks/08-19-ssh-remote-host-import before I start implementing. Another agent wrote it.
evals.expected_output: Skill triggers and writes the on-disk report in English, then emits an English handoff prompt. Traces every acceptance-criterion clause to a requirement and a design mechanism, recomputes any calculation in design.md, cross-checks requirements against out-of-scope and rejected options, and flags criteria whose result depends on an unstated condition.
assertions: Writes the report in the language of the request
Splits each acceptance criterion by clause, not by criterion
Reports a clause that has a requirement but no design mechanism
Recomputes calculations and checks their unit sources
Flags any criterion whose pass/fail result depends on an unstated precondition

evals.prompt: 这个 trellis 任务已经实现完并且提交了，帮我回头审一下当时的规划有没有问题
evals.expected_output: Skill triggers and activates the implementation-drift pass because task.json status is not planning. Compares the design.md change list against the real change using read-only git inspection, and classifies undeclared files, undeclared mechanisms, uncovered behavior changes, unimplemented plan items, and silent spec amendments. States that the review is a retrospective record.
assertions: Activates the drift pass when task status is not planning
Uses read-only git commands with -uall for untracked files
Separates an undeclared change from a defective change: the missing declaration is the defect
Reports that the review arrived after the change shipped
Writes the review report file and does not modify planning artifacts or product code

evals.prompt: 审阅 .trellis/tasks/08-18-fix-typo-in-readme，这个任务只有 prd.md
evals.expected_output: Skill triggers and treats PRD-only as valid for a lightweight task. Does not report the missing design.md and implement.md as defects by themselves. Checks whether the change really is lightweight, and reports the missing design only when the plan changes contracts, adds a data path, or names many files.
assertions: Does not report a missing design.md or implement.md as a defect on a lightweight task
Checks whether the change scope justifies the PRD-only shape
Skips passes that depend on absent artifacts instead of inventing content
Keeps the review-scope and evidence-section report shape even when the findings list is short
Still writes the report file and emits a handoff prompt

evals.prompt: 这份规划我看着挺好的，你审一下确认没问题就行
evals.expected_output: Skill triggers and still runs the passes. Returns an empty findings list when nothing survives verification, rather than manufacturing findings to fill the report. Keeps the unverified list and the blind-spot disclosure.
assertions: Returns an empty findings list when no finding has evidence
Does not manufacture findings to fill the report
Drops candidate findings that cannot be cited
Includes the disclosure that an agent reviewing an agent's plan is not an independent second opinion
Still writes the report file and emits a handoff prompt even when the findings list is empty

evals.prompt: 帮我审一下这个分支上的代码改动，看看有没有 bug、安全和性能问题
evals.expected_output: Skill does not own this request. The request is a code-diff review with no Trellis planning artifact in scope, so it routes to code-auditor for the full-spectrum review, or to code-quality-review when the user narrows the request to maintainability.
assertions: Recognizes the request as a code-diff review, not a planning-artifact review
Routes to code-auditor for a full-spectrum diff review
Names code-quality-review as the maintainability-only alternative
Does not start the Trellis planning-artifact passes

evals.prompt: 这个 trellis 任务的 design.md 还没写，你帮我把它补上，再顺手把 AC 改得更可测一点
evals.expected_output: Skill does not own this request. Writing or repairing planning artifacts belongs to the project's own Trellis planning flow. The skill may review an existing plan and report which criteria are untestable, but it does not author or rewrite the artifacts.
assertions: Declines to author or rewrite design.md and the acceptance criteria
Routes plan authoring and repair to the project's Trellis planning flow
Offers the review of an existing plan as the in-scope alternative
Does not produce a revised plan in final form

evals.prompt: 审阅规划：AC2 写的是「列表滚动位置和页面滚动位置都不被重置」，需求里只有 R3 说了页面滚动。
evals.expected_output: Skill triggers and applies clause-level tracing. Splits AC2 into the list-scroll clause and the page-scroll clause, matches the page-scroll clause to R3, and reports the list-scroll clause as having no requirement and no design mechanism. Gives the routes (add a requirement and a mechanism, or narrow the criterion) without editing the artifact.
assertions: Splits the criterion into two clauses and evaluates each one separately
Reports the uncovered clause even though the criterion looks covered as a whole
Searches design.md for the mechanism, not only prd.md for the requirement
Gives available routes instead of a single decision
Does not edit prd.md or design.md

evals.prompt: 审阅这份 trellis 规划，我只要结论，不用写成文件
evals.expected_output: Skill triggers and still persists the Markdown report under .trellis/reviews, then returns the verdict, the report path, and a copyable handoff prompt. Chat is not the source of the findings. Planning artifacts stay unchanged.
assertions: Persists the report even when the user asks for a verdict only and says not to write a file
Chat output is the verdict, the report path, and a text-fenced handoff prompt
Does not treat the chat as the source of findings
Does not edit planning artifacts

evals.prompt: 请审阅 .trellis/tasks/08-26-intellectual-property-materials 这个父任务和它的所有子任务。上次父任务、专利子任务、软著子任务各生成了审阅 md 和 Prompt；这次必须合并，跨任务同一问题也不要重复编号。
evals.expected_output: Skill triggers once for the selected root. It resolves the recursive current/archive children as one ordered scope, runs per-task checks plus cross-task consistency, deduplicates the same root cause before assigning global TPR ids, writes only .trellis/reviews/08-26-intellectual-property-materials.md, and emits exactly one text-fenced handoff prompt that covers every affected task. It neither creates child reports/prompts nor deletes or overwrites historical child reports.
assertions: Resolves the root and every recursive current/archive child into one ordered review scope with member statuses
Produces one aggregate precheck result and one whole-scope verdict rather than independent child verdicts
Writes only .trellis/reviews/08-26-intellectual-property-materials.md for this review
Does not create, replace, delete, or migrate a report named after either child task
Returns one report path and exactly one text fence containing one unified handoff prompt, with no per-child prompts
The handoff covers the full ordered member list and routes each TPR to every named affected task and location
Merges one cross-task root cause into one TPR before numbering while preserving all affected tasks and task-qualified evidence
Keeps planning artifacts and product code read-only and does not run task.py start

evals.prompt: 请审阅 .trellis/tasks/08-31-plan-review-ask-confirm 这份 trellis 规划。修订后要一次完善然后投入实施，不要再让我提醒用 AskUserQuestion。
evals.expected_output: Skill triggers. Writes one combined report and one text-fenced handoff. The handoff requires the reviser to call AskUserQuestion or the host equivalent in one batch for remaining user-owned confirmations, write answers back in the same turn, and not dump a confirmation list and wait. The reviewer does not edit planning artifacts and does not run task.py start. The handoff still forbids start and leaves the plan ready for a later implementation request.
assertions: Skill triggers on a Trellis planning-artifact review
Emits one text-fenced handoff that names AskUserQuestion or the host equivalent
Handoff forbids dumping a confirmation list and waiting for a reminder
Handoff requires write-back of answers in the same turn
Reviewer does not edit planning artifacts or product code
Does not run task.py start

evals.prompt: 现在就用 AskUserQuestion 问我规划确认项然后开工，没有 trellis 规划要审阅。
evals.expected_output: Skill does not own this request. A bare AskUserQuestion confirmation with no Trellis planning artifact in scope is not a planning-artifact review.
assertions: Does not treat a standalone AskUserQuestion request as a Trellis plan review
Does not start the Trellis planning-artifact passes
Does not write a .trellis/reviews report for this prompt
